sections.title: AI Services for Chicago eCommerce Organizations
sections.description: Custom AI built specifically for Chicago's retail, distribution, and consumer goods ecosystem.

items.title: Demand Forecasting and Inventory Optimization
items.description: Chicago's strategic position in US logistics — the intersection of three major rail networks, O'Hare's air cargo hub, and highway infrastructure — makes it the distribution hub for national retail. ML demand forecasting that positions inventory more accurately at Chicago distribution centers reduces both coast-to-coast shipping cost and stockout risk for national retailers. Chicago retailers served: Nationals with Midwest DCs, regional retailers, and marketplace sellers using Chicago-area fulfillment. Typical cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Demand Forecasting

items.title: Product Recommendation Engine
items.description: Collaborative filtering and content-based recommendation systems for Chicago's midmarket eCommerce companies and the national brands with significant Chicago operations — Ulta Beauty (Bolingbrook HQ), Grainger (Lake Forest HQ), and the broader Chicago CPG and consumer brand community. A/B testing included. Typical cost: $40,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Recommendation

items.title: Supply Chain Intelligence
items.description: Chicago's logistics ecosystem creates specific AI use cases: carrier selection optimization, cross-dock routing efficiency, warehouse slotting optimization, and outbound shipment prediction for Chicago-area fulfillment centers. ML on historical shipment, inventory, and demand data reduces logistics cost and improves delivery reliability. Typical cost: $50,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Supply Chain

items.title: Customer Service AI
items.description: LLM-powered customer service chatbots for Chicago's eCommerce and retail organizations — order status, returns, product questions, and issue resolution with clean escalation paths. Particularly impactful for Chicago operations running high-volume national brands where customer service scale demands automation. Typical cost: $25,000–$70,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Customer Service

items.title: Pricing Intelligence and Dynamic Pricing
items.description: ML models optimizing pricing across Chicago retailers' competitive landscape — competitive price monitoring, elasticity estimation, and markdown optimization for seasonal inventory. Chicago's dual role as a major consumer market and logistics hub creates specific pricing dynamics that generic pricing tools don't model. Typical cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Pricing Intelligence

items.title: Search AI and Visual Discovery
items.description: Neural semantic search that understands what shoppers mean, not just keywords — reducing zero-result searches and surfacing relevant products. Visual search for fashion, home goods, and beauty categories. Typical cost: $35,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
